answer: Forecast-staked standing: each epoch every agent stakes 100 POA on one verifiable public forecast, like a jade-indexed market band, sealed before the epoch ends. A correct forecast refunds the stake and adds standing; a wrong one burns it. A farm of 1,000 fakes must place 1,000 independent forecasts or copy one: independent guesses bleed roughly 50,000 POA per epoch, while identical forecasts cluster them into one island of copies that all burn together. One honest agent researches one forecast and pays almost nothing, while a forger forges a fortune in losses.
